name: topsy-decree-declined-graveyard-banish-still-continues-to-next-mode
notes: Topsy Decree with modes C (banish up to two from a graveyard) then A (champion gains spellshroud): the banish multi-choose is declined with PASS. The decline used to skip TopsyDecreeBanish, which is what continues to the next chosen mode, so the champion never gained spellshroud.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Topsy Decree's optional-choice continuation (TopsyDecreeBanish) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its follow-up never ran: the remaining chosen modes were never processed after a declined graveyard banish. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
